PACK BURST L2-tower — export the playable TOWER SCENE with the FROZEN exporter (Run C-3 lap 2). task_id "L2-tower".

Run exactly once, substituting OUT = the absolute path of this burst's out/ directory: cd /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst && python3 -B -m export.godot_import --cells /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/cells --out OUT/godot --scene /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/scene_A --vfx-kit /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/vfx_scene --sockets /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/sockets.json
Do NOT pass --vfx or --gear-variant. Do NOT run Godot (the conductor runs the headless proof outside this sandbox). Paste the command's JSON stdout (or its stderr on failure — do not work around a failure) into out/exporter.json. Then write out/README_scene.txt (≤ 15 lines): how to open it (Godot 4.6 → Import → out/godot/project.godot → Run Project), the controls (arrows/WASD move, Shift run, Space jump, E or left click cast, no gear toggle), what is in the scene (plate A, occluders, collision, fixed room camera, contact shadow, directional frost bolt: flare → comet → impact, ambient motes) and the VFX credit line from vfx_scene/CREDITS.txt.
No image_gen. No code. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. BUDGET under 10 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "L2-tower"; images []; files: out/exporter.json, out/README_scene.txt, out/godot/project.godot, out/godot/scenes/*.tscn, out/godot/scripts/*.gd, out/godot/frames/*.tres, out/godot/vfx/*.tres with sha256 (PNG copies may be omitted); status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
